top_signals.title: Ukraine Grain Exports to Slump After Russian Strikes on Odesa
top_signals.summary: Ukraine’s agricultural shipments could fall by more than half this season after Russian attacks disrupted Black Sea ports, threatening the country’s biggest source of export revenue.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Crypto’s infrastructure era arrives, with AI agents poised to reshape demand
top_signals.summary: Crypto companies are trying to build a second growth engine by turning agents into the next wave of users.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Mexico Arrests Ex-Governor Over 2014 Student Abduction Case
top_signals.summary: Mexican authorities detained a former governor over charges he concealed evidence in the more than decade-old abduction and presumed murder of dozens of students training to be teachers, one of the country’s most infamous criminal cases.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Cassidy supports Todd Blanche, rescuing Trump's embattled attorney general pick
top_signals.summary: Attorney General nominee Todd Blanche needs at least 50 votes on the Senate floor to be confirmed after clearing the Senate Judiciary Committee.

top_signals.title: K-shaped economy shows up in housing: Luxury sales rise as starter-home buyers struggle
top_signals.summary: Even as luxury homes fly off the market, sales of starter homes are down despite growing inventory and more price cuts, research shows.

top_signals.title: Senate delays Clarity Act vote until after August recess, Thune confirms
top_signals.summary: Senate Majority Leader John Thune confirmed with The Block, saying: 'We're getting that queued up first thing when we come back.'
